note: Corps of Engineers campground on Barren River Lake near Scottsville, the largest on the lake, with five loops on a series of wooded points and private coves for swimming or mooring a boat. Two playgrounds, volleyball and basketball courts, amphitheater, boat ramp and nature trails. Day visitors pay a fee. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on rec.gov: 215 sites, $22-34, 50A + water (no sewer), dump and drinking water, showers (recent review), 14-night limit, season Apr 16 (2027) to Oct 24 (2026). Lakefront CONFIRMED: loop D point sites D04/D06/D08/D10 ~22-24 m from the shoreline, loop A A22/A23 ~30-33 m and loop B B45-B47 ~29-42 m, over open ground.
flags: WATERFRONT CONFIRMED (stored lakefront): rec.gov carries no per-site water tag here. Plotted on leaf-off Esri imagery with the lake near pool (water at the treeline/riprap): D04 (36.884365,-86.095091), D06 (36.883995,-86.095163), D08 (36.883578,-86.095007) and D10 (36.883322,-86.094746) are ~22-24 m from the shore over open, lightly wooded ground with a low sand bank; A22 (36.889713,-86.098968) and A23 (36.889675,-86.098639) ~30-33 m over open grass/sand; B45 (36.887543,-86.097790), B46 (36.887318,-86.097638) and B47 (36.887168,-86.097247) ~29-42 m across the loop road to a riprap shore. All sold by the night on rec.gov; D04, B46 and B47 have 25-ft spurs, D06/D08/D10/A22/A23 40-65 ft. A September 2026 Google review ('33-foot motorhome... Our site was right on the lake') agrees.
FACILITIES: laundry (stored, from the old note) is not mentioned on rec.gov and could not be confirmed; left as stored. Flush toilets are likely with the shower houses but not stated, so not written.
